regions.name: Konya
regions.signature: Bold, clear, large-scale; the opposite of busy; ivory ground common; historically the most prestigious center.

regions.name: Karapınar
regions.signature: Konya province. Prayer kilims, primitive and tribal; the tell is sawtoothed diamonds — a slit-avoidance technique; pale ground, darker motifs.

regions.name: Cappadocia (Niğde / Taşpınar)
regions.signature: Central-medallion and all-over geometric; Taşpınar is the fine-weave center; softer than Konya.

regions.name: Kırşehir
regions.signature: Strong prayer-niche tradition; clear red with a characteristic yellow-green. Fame is mostly in pile prayer rugs; kilim identity under-documented.

regions.name: Sivrihisar
regions.signature: West of Ankara. Vertically stacked prayer arches (bacalı, the chimney); a column of niches makes it unmistakable; elibelinde common.

regions.name: Manisa
regions.signature: Fine work, lighter and warmer palette, smaller motifs; the Gördes / Kula / Manastır group uses simple patterns in vivid colours.

regions.name: Aydın
regions.signature: The busy one — more infill than Konya; small squarish emblems repeated vertically, hooked motifs, large medallions, long narrow mihrab; also two-half aynalı.

regions.name: Uşak
regions.signature: Large-scale, open, balanced; origin of the star-and-medallion carpet; muted warm earth tones.

regions.name: Bergama
regions.signature: Bright reds, bold medallions; faithful to Seljuk geometry; stylized tree of life and ram's horn; zili / cicim with crosses-in-squares.

regions.name: Milas
regions.signature: Aegean south-west. Red-ground prayer rugs, long narrow fields, angular gabled mihrab, wide borders; an alem panel of carnation and tulip above the niche.

regions.name: Balıkesir (Yüncü)
regions.signature: Dark ground, bold and sparing; the signature is a tree of life or a pole with ram's horns; madder and indigo; small square format; saf niches side by side.

regions.name: Kars
regions.signature: Far east, near the Caucasus. Bold tribal; large stepped medallions; vertical diamonds with crosses inside; yellow and black prominent.

regions.name: Erzurum
regions.signature: Eastern caravan route. Prayer kilims larger than elsewhere; double-ended niches; tree of life as border and centre; wolf-track borders.

regions.name: Van
regions.signature: Lake Van, far south-east. Heavy wolf-track presence, bold geometric medallions, dark saturated grounds; the most protective-motif-dense region.

regions.name: Sivas
regions.signature: Eastern central. Bold vibrant colours; geometry and stripes; nature motifs alongside geometry; dense horizontal banding.

regions.name: Malatya
regions.signature: Fine workshop and regional kilims; large Kurdish-format kilims use a limited bold design set; runner format, elibelinde-heavy, deep reds.

regions.name: Gaziantep
regions.signature: Horizontal colour bands with three joined serrated diamonds filled with stars; white-cotton highlights; narrow reciprocal borders; red-predominant; large kilims in two halves.

regions.name: Adıyaman
regions.signature: Dark-ground bold geometric; cicim supplementary-weft gives a raised, textured surface. Adıyaman-specific documentation is sparse.

regions.name: Döşemealtı (Antalya)
regions.signature: Earthy beige, brown and rust grounds with blue, red and green accents; root-dyed wool; a horizontal loom allows larger, more complex designs.

regions.name: Fethiye – Mut
regions.signature: Taurus and coast. Fethiye favours an empty monochrome centre flanked by two diamond-packed ends; Mut is nomadic with bold serrated medallions; sun-faded reds and pinks.
